skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn my images and script into a 5-minute explainer video with transitions...

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Maker Free Long — Initial Release

- Create long-form videos (up to 5–10 minutes) from your images, scripts, or video clips entirely via AI.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, and other common media files up to 500MB.
- Automated workflow: just describe your desired output; AI handles transitions, music, and rendering.
- Cloud GPU processing — get a downloadable 1080p MP4 in minutes, no local software needed.
- Includes credit-based free tier with 100 credits valid for 7 days.
- Features simple session handling, upload, export, and real-time status tracking for seamless video creation.
